args.title: Fix password reset email link to use the correct public URL
args.body: Issue 4201 reports that the password reset email generated by the application contains a link to a localhost address, which does not work for users. The current code in src/notifications/templates.ts sets the base URL for links to `http://localhost:3000` unless overridden by the environment variable `PUBLIC_URL`. This change updates the code to ensure that the generated URL is the correct public URL, allowing users to reset their passwords successfully without being redirected to a local server.
